messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE FIRED — inference-service-eu (PDR-8421). Symptom: rolling p99 latency > 2400ms for 5m. Trigger: alert 'inference.latency.p99.eu'.

jay: taking it — oncall.
anya: ack, joining. checking autoscaler + kvcache.
mike: looking at dedicated pool metrics, seeing elevated GPU mem & some evictions.
anya: logs show kvcache eviction spikes at 13:02 UTC, looks like a prefix replay storm from a heavy batching customer.
jay: any customer-facing 5xxs?
mike: a small uptick in 502s for EU region on the hot route, correlated with the latency bursts.
anya: recommendation: disable prefix batching shadowing for the hot route to stop regen traffic. quick rollback if bad.
jay: go for it @anya. runbook ref: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-high-latency (see step "kvcache eviction / batch storm").
anya: executing mitigation — setting ROUTE_BATCHING=false for route "customer-hot" in eu-prod.
anya: ```bash
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-route-hot ROUTE_BATCHING=false --record
```
mike: applied kvcache tuning on pool-3 (reduced max_kv_size) and restarted a misbehaving pod; tailing logs.
jay: pinging @cs-team to prep a standby customer update if this degrades.
pagerbot: PagerDuty PAGER12345 acknowledged by jay (oncall) at 1769999962.
anya: p99 dropping — now ~900ms over the last 30s :thumbsup:.
mike: GPU memory stabilized, eviction logs cleared.
jay: good. switching to watch mode. @anya can you hold 30m for handoff?
anya: yes, will stay 30m then hand off to mike for overnight follow-up.
jay: documenting actions in incident tracker and linking alert: https://alerts.redwood/pdr-8421
incident-bot: PAGE RESOLVED — alert cleared. Duration ~8m. Summary: mitigation = disabled batching on hot route + kvcache tune; visible customer impact = transient 502s for a small set of EU customers.
incident-bot: ACTIONS: eng-runtime to add prefix-storm detection + auto-throttling; assign owner: mike.
mike: noted, I'll own the follow-up and draft a short postmortem.
jay: thanks team. great triage. :pray:
